indication: FET-PET imaging of glioma: differentiating recurrent or progressive glioma from treatment-related change, adults and pediatric patients
headline: Pixclara (floretyrosine F 18, TLX101-Px) approved as the first FDA-approved FET-PET imaging drug for glioma; Telix announced the approval on Sep 14 2026.
pdufa_note: The PDUFA goal date was September 11, 2026, sourced to Telix's NDA-acceptance release of April 10, 2026. Telix announced on September 14 that the FDA had approved the NDA; the announcement does not state the day the agency acted and Drugs@FDA does not yet hold a Pixclara record, so the decision date here is the announcement date, 3 days after the goal. If the FDA's letter is dated earlier the margin will be corrected from the letter. The NDA was a March 16, 2026 resubmission after an earlier Complete Response Letter.
